contentPattern.structure: single external video URL (optional poster image) rendered as a responsive iframe player

suitableFor: embedding external third-party video (Vimeo, YouTube) via a URL
single featured video sections such as 'Watch our TV advert'
lazy-loaded / click-to-play video embeds with an optional poster image
notSuitableFor: self-hosted video files with a native player (use the vanilla video block)
social post embeds (use an embed social variant)
galleries of multiple rotating videos (use a carousel)
